arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Kagan argued that the transfer divests the government of the property.
She stated that the Establishment Clause does not prohibit this sensible action.
She noted that the district court gave Congress two basic options.
She argued that the private group can remove the memorial if it chooses.
